name: emulator-claim
about: #546: an item triage tagged with resources=[emulator] reaches a runner that has the capability, and the run finally says what that means. The agent's own sandbox can never reach an emulator (no /dev/kvm, no Android tooling, adb denied), so the build's brief names the item's resources and the route it does have: here the mobile repo's verify steps, which run in the runner's fence after the agent. An emulator item on a repo with no route at all (no harness for its agents, no verify step) does not start an agent: the run fails with what to add to the runner's config and the item goes to the user.
